[SWS_DM_01111] Fault detection counter for combined events
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04200
⌈
If event combination is used for the
events
of an DTC, the DM shall calculate the
fault detection counter (FDC) of that DTC by taking the greatest fault detection counter
value of the sub-events.
⌋
